Clear by design

Site information & privacy.

Who publishes this site?

honeybees.consulting is the consulting brand presented by Daksh Mehta, based in Paris, France.

For questions about the website or your information, write to Dakshmehta077@gmail.com.

Your inputs stay on your device.

The calculator and priority guide run in your browser. The contact form creates an email draft in your own email application. Form entries and calculator values are not submitted to a honeybees server or saved by this website.

When you choose to send an email, its contents are handled by your email provider and the recipient’s email service. Daksh uses enquiry information to respond and discuss the requested work. You can contact him to ask about or request deletion of that correspondence.

Language preference and analytics.

The site remembers your language and calm-mode choices in your browser’s local storage (honeybee-language, honeybee-motion), and that you have seen the opening animation in session storage (honeybee-loaded). You can clear it in your browser’s site-data settings. No analytics, advertising pixels, tracking cookies or embedded third-party forms are added by this site. Fonts and images are hosted with the site.

Hosting and external links.

The public version is hosted on GitHub Pages. Hosting providers may process connection information such as IP addresses and request logs to operate their services. External resource links take you to other websites, which have their own privacy policies.

GitHub’s privacy statement ↗

Images, background and business examples.

The founder portrait and background are drawn from Daksh’s public portfolio. The bee photograph is an illustrative image created for this website using image generation. It does not document a client project or an environmental result. The bee logo is an original vector design.

Calculator defaults are illustrative assumptions, not promised savings or results from honeybees clients. Framework names describe areas of support and do not imply an accreditation, affiliation or guaranteed assessment outcome.

Discussing a project.

Sending an enquiry does not create a consulting agreement. Scope, deliverables, schedule, pricing and any information-sharing arrangements are agreed separately before a project begins.
